class nvitk.core.config.CoreConfig¶

Immutable snapshot of NVITK_* settings used by nvitk.core.backend.

backend_preference¶

auto tries GPU when available; numpy / cupy force a family; cupy_required raises if CuPy cannot run.

cuda_device¶

Optional device index from NVITK_CUDA_DEVICE.

warn_on_fallback¶

When True, emit warnings if CuPy was requested but NumPy is used.

backend_preference: BackendPreference = 'auto'¶
